# Shyam Metalics Q3 FY26 Earnings Results

Shyam Metalics is primarily engaged in the manufacturing of steel and allied products including pellets, sponge iron, TMT and long products, ferro alloys and generation of power.

## Q3 FY26 Earnings Results

- Revenue from Operations: ₹4,421 Crore, +17.7% YoY, -1.0% QoQ
- EBITDA: ₹539 cr, +6.3% YoY, -11.5% QoQ, operating EBITDA ₹487 Crore +6.9% YoY, 12.2% margin
- PAT: ₹198 cr, +0.1% YoY, -24.7% QoQ
- Other key metrics: Volumes +25% YoY, 9M YTD revenue
